{{Quote|Jedi Knight Khen Reo, who brought law to the Null Sectors.|[[Oniye Namada]] in her [[I-1807-VAK|report]]|<ref name="TTF2" />}}
'''Khen Reo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], becoming something of a war hero on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vaklin]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|female]], Khen Reo was [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] by the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], attaining the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]]. During her service to the Order and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], Khen Reo became renowned for bringing peace to the [[Null Sectors]]. In recognition of her service, the people of [[Vaklin]] erected a statue to memorialize Reo's heroics in a public square. In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]], following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] under [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and the destruction of the Jedi Order, Reo's statue was destroyed as a means of wiping out all memory of the Order's existence.<ref name="TTF2" />
